title: Warble fly
blurb: Warble fly is a name given to the genus Hypoderma: large flies which are parasitic on cattle and deer.
facts: Larvae of Hypoderma species also have been reported in horses, sheep, goats and humans.
They have also been found on smaller mammals such as dogs, cats, squirrels, voles and rabbits.
